decision: One shared shell contract across web, iOS, and Android with platform-appropriate presentation but common authority and state semantics.
Desktop/tablet use a persistent or collapsible rail; compact mobile uses a bounded bottom navigation plus an accessible More destination.
Landing and ordering are persona-aware: horse-first for owners, task-first for staff, schedule/training-first for trainers, operations-first for facility administrators.
Multi-tenant and multi-facility users receive an explicit active-context indicator and controlled switcher; context is never silently inferred.
Global search is active-context and permission bound; identifiable cross-tenant discovery is prohibited by default.
A command palette may navigate and invoke bounded actions, with separate execution-time authorization.
Quick Create is limited to registered domain-owned forms and current create authority.
Recents, pins, favorites, and saved views are private, reauthorized on every read, and suppressed when authority ends.
The shell supports useful degraded/offline states without treating cached visibility as continuing authority.
Public and pre-authentication routes use a separate minimal shell without private taxonomy, counts, names, recents, or tenant structure.
Semantic or AI retrieval is separately gated and default OFF in the initial core shell.
The Founder-approved visual-system V0.3.1 remains immutable and incorporated by exact bytes and SHA-256, never silently rewritten.
